sections.heading: ¿Qué es el subjuntivo en inglés?
sections.body: El subjuntivo en inglés utiliza la forma base del verbo (infinitivo sin 'to') para todas las personas, independientemente del sujeto y el tiempo. Se utiliza para expresar mandatos, sugerencias o requerimientos formales: 'It is vital that he attend the meeting' (no 'attends').

sections.heading: Verbos y adjetivos que lo activan
sections.body: Aparece tras verbos de orden, sugerencia o demanda seguidos de 'that': *insist, suggest, recommend, demand, request, propose, require, urge*. También tras adjetivos de necesidad e importancia: *vital, essential, important, necessary, crucial, imperative* ('It is essential that she be informed').

sections.heading: El subjuntivo con 'were' (Were-Subjunctive)
sections.body: En situaciones hipotéticas o contrarias a la realidad (como en el segundo condicional), el inglés formal usa 'were' para todas las personas gramaticales: 'If I were you...', 'If she were here...', 'I wish it were true'.

examples.english: I suggest that she be promoted.
It is vital that he attend the meeting.
They demanded that the report be submitted immediately.
If I were taller, I would play basketball.

exercises.instruction: Completa cada oración con la forma correcta del verbo en subjuntivo.
items: It's essential that every student ___ (submit) the form.
I recommend that he ___ (take) the earlier flight.
If I ___ (be) you, I would reconsider.
The committee insisted that she ___ (be) present.

quiz.question: ¿Cuál de las siguientes oraciones utiliza correctamente el subjuntivo en inglés?
options: She insisted that he leaves immediately.
She insisted that he leave immediately.
She insisted that he is leaving immediately.
She insisted that he left immediately.
quiz.explanation: Tras 'insist that', el inglés formal requiere la forma base del verbo ('leave'), sin 's' de tercera persona.
